test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

He __gnashed his teeth__ at his son's actions.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. expressed rage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"gnashed"** means to grind one's teeth together, typically as a sign of anger. (दांत पीसना)

 

 
• **Example: **He gnashed his teeth in frustration when he missed the winning shot.

 

 

 
• **"expressed rage"** refers to showing intense anger. (क्रोध व्यक्त करना)

 

 
• **Example: **He expressed rage when he found out his car was towed.

 

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. exp
